license_required.quote: A person who, not being licensed, advertises or holds himself or herself out to the public as described in section 1311 of this title, or who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title.

name.quote: "Board" means the Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title.

type.quote: "Board" means the Board of Medical Practice established under section 1351 of this title.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Department of Health shall collect the following fees

age_minimum.quote: is at least 18 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: is of sound moral character and professional competence

degree_required.quote: has graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board, or from a medical school that has been approved by the Board by rule, with a degree of doctor of medicine or an equivalent as may be determined by the Board

accrediting_body.quote: graduated from a medical school accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

required.quote: shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

duration.value: at least two years (U.S./Canadian graduates); at least three years (foreign graduates)
duration.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training

kind.quote: successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

exams.name: Medical licensing examination (as established by Board rule; e.g., USMLE or COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Board may identify accepted examinations, set passing standards, and set limits on time and numbers of attempts
exams.quote: An applicant shall satisfy the Board's requirements for medical licensing examination as established by the Board by rule.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.
interval_years.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

required.quote: A licensee for renewal of an active license to practice medicine shall have completed continuing medical education that shall meet minimum criteria as established by rule
required.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall require a minimum of 10 hours of continuing medical education by rule.
hours_per_period.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

period_years.quote: Every person licensed to practice medicine by the Board shall apply biennially for the renewal of his or her license.
period_years.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

value: updated knowledge and skills in own specialties
advances in other fields for which patient referrals may be appropriate
current professional competence in recognizing the need for timely appropriate consultations and referrals
treatments such as those offered by hospice, palliative care, and pain management services
topical_requirements.quote: The training provided by the continuing medical education shall be designed to assure that the licensee has updated his or her knowledge and skills in his or her own specialties and also has kept abreast of advances in other fields for which patient referrals may be appropriate.
topical_requirements.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

available.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States

requirements.value: Not more than three years of practice in good standing in another U.S. jurisdiction; must meet postgraduate training requirements (2 years for U.S./Canadian graduates, 3 years for foreign graduates)
requirements.quote: The Board shall have an endorsement process for physician licensure that requires not more than three years of practice in good standing in another jurisdiction within the United States, regardless of whether that jurisdiction has licensing requirements substantially equal to those of this State

regulatory_model.quote: A person who, not being licensed, advertises or holds himself or herself out to the public as described in section 1311 of this title, or who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title

credential_type.quote: "License" means license to practice medicine and surgery in the State as defined in subchapter 3 of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: A person who, not being licensed, advertises or holds himself or herself out to the public as described in section 1311 of this title, or who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title ... shall be imprisoned not more than two years or fined not more than $10,000.00, or both.

title_protection.quote: using the designation "Doctor," "Doctor of Medicine," "Physician," "Dr.," "M.D.," or any combination thereof in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition

scope_protection.quote: who, not being licensed, practices medicine as defined in section 1311 of this title ... shall be imprisoned not more than two years or fined not more than $10,000.00, or both.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or its renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a medical license or in connection with applying for or procuring periodic renewal of a medical license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising about health care services intended or tending to mislead or deceive the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: all advertising about health care services or a medical business that is intended or has a tendency to mislead or deceive the public or impose upon credulous or ignorant persons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abandonment of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that impair the licensee's ability to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion of sale of drugs or devices to exploit the patient for financial gain, or prescribing drugs for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: promotion by a physician of the sale of drugs, devices, appliances, or goods provided for a patient in such a manner as to exploit the patient for financial gain of the physician or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than legal and legitimate therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct that evidences unfitness to practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making and filing false reports or records in practice as a physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully making and filing false reports or records in his or her practice as a physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make available promptly to a patient or their representative copies of that person's records upon proper written request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to make available promptly to a person using professional health care services, that person's representative, succeeding health care professionals, or institutions, when given proper written request

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for professional services for any person for bringing to or referring a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful misrepresentation in treatments
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willful misrepresentation in treatments

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding or abetting such physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing medicine with a physician who is not legally practicing within the State, or aiding or abetting such physician in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing false statements for collection of fees for services not rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gross overcharging for professional services on repeated occasions, including filing of false statements for collection of fees for which services are not rendered

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: professional incompetency resulting from physical or mental impairment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross failure to use the degree of care, skill, and proficiency commonly exercised by an ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in the course of practice, gross failure to use and exercise on a particular occasion or the failure to use and exercise on repeated occasions, that degree of care, skill, and proficiency that is commonly exercised by the ordinary skillful, careful, and prudent physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or other disciplinary sanction of a license to practice medicine by another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: revocation of a license to practice medicine or surgery, or other disciplinary sanction, by another jurisdiction on one or more of the grounds specified in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a restricted or conditioned license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with an order of the Board or violation of any term or condition of a license that is restricted or conditioned by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practice of profession when medically or psychologically unfit to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegation of professional responsibilities to a person not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegation of professional responsibilities, including delivery of any health care services, to a person whom the licensed professional knows, or has reason to know, is not qualified by training, experience, education, or licensing credentials to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession or conviction of a felony, or failure to report such conviction to the Board within 30 days
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime related to the practice of the profession or conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of the profession, or failure to report to the Board a conviction of any crime related to the practice of the profession or any felony in any court within 30 days of the conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing, prescribing, or dispensing medication via electronic means without establishing a proper physician-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior that interferes with patient care or could adversely affect the quality of care rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disruptive behavior that involves interaction with physicians, hospital personnel, office staff, patients, or support persons of the patient or others that interferes with patient care or could reasonably be expected to adversely affect the quality of care rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commission of any sexual misconduct that exploits the physician-patient relationship, including sexual contact with a patient, surrogates, or key third parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, selling, administering, or dispensing a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing, selling, administering, distributing, ordering, or dispensing any drug legally classified as a controlled substance for the licensee's own use or to an immediate family member as defined by rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of conversion therapy on a client younger than 18 years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of conversion therapy as defined in 18 V.S.A. § 8351 on a client younger than 18 years of age

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice competently, including performance of unsafe patient care or failure to conform to essential standards of acceptable and prevailing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to practice competently by reason of any cause on a single occasion or on multiple occasions constitutes unprofessional conduct. Failure to practice competently includes, as determined by the Board: (1) performance of unsafe or unacceptable patient care; or (2) failure to conform to the essential standards of acceptable and prevailing practice.

citations.cite: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

definition_quote.value: offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care
definition_quote.quote: offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person, including the management of all aspects of pregnancy, labor and delivery, and postpartum care

value: prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition
prescribing, ordering, giving, or administering any drug or medicine
rendering medical opinions concerning diagnosis or treatment
methods_authorized.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person; offering or undertaking to prevent, diagnose, correct, or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices any disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of any person; offering or undertaking to perform any surgical operation upon any person

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs or medicine; controlled substances may be prescribed subject to restrictions
drug_authority.quote: offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of any other person

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must complete at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian accredited program and must submit evidence of ECFMG certification unless qualifying as a Fifth Pathway applicant
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A graduate of a Board-approved medical school outside the United States or Canada shall submit evidence of success of completing at least three years of postgraduate training in a U.S. or Canadian program accredited by an organization that is acceptable to the Board

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: A graduate of a U.S. or Canadian medical school accredited by a body that is acceptable to the Board shall submit evidence of the successful completion of at least two years of postgraduate training

pain_management_education_required.quote: The Board shall require evidence of current professional competence in recognizing the need for timely appropriate consultations and referrals to assure fully informed patient choice of treatment options, including treatments such as those offered by hospice, palliative care, and pain management services.
pain_management_education_required.citation: § 1400. Renewal of license; continuing medical education

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Prescribing via electronic means requires reasonable effort to verify patient identity, establishment of documented diagnosis through accepted medical practices, and maintenance of a current medical record; electronic evaluation by questionnaire alone is inadequate for initial evaluation except for medication abortion
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: providing, prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing medical services or prescription medication or prescription-only devices to a person in response to any communication transmitted or received by computer or other electronic means, when the licensee fails to take the following actions to establish and maintain a proper physician-patient relationship: (i) a reasonable effort to verify that the person requesting medication is in fact the patient, and is in fact who the person claims to be; (ii) establishment of documented diagnosis through the use of accepted medical practices; and (iii) maintenance of a current medical record

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: This subchapter is the Vermont adoption of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact as revised by the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The Board or the Executive Director of the Board may waive supervision and scope of practice requirements for physician assistants, including the requirement for documentation of the relationship between a physician assistant and a physician pursuant to section 1735a of this title.
physician_assistant_supervision_model.citation: § 1353. Powers and duties of the Board

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: All medical malpractice court judgments and all medical malpractice arbitration awards in which a payment is awarded to a complaining party during the last 10 years, and all settlements of medical malpractice claims in which a payment is made to a complaining party within the last 10 years.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A description of revocation or involuntary restriction of hospital privileges for reasons related to competence or character that has been issued by the hospital's governing body or any other official of the hospital after procedural due process has been afforded

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: the Board shall use at least $25.00 of this fee to support the cost of maintaining the Vermont Practitioner Recovery Network, which, for the protection of the public, monitors and evaluates, coordinates services for, and promotes rehabilitation of licensees who have or potentially have an impaired ability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require a licensee or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination, and an evaluation of medical knowledge and skill by individuals or entities designated by the Board if the Board has a reasonable basis to believe a licensee or applicant may be incompetent or unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety.
compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.citation: § 1353. Powers and duties of the Board
